title: The Nap Map
skill_description: Practice reading CVC words with short vowels. Focus on -ap and -ed word families.
author: FunBookies
summary: Sleepy Ned finds a magical map under his pillow that promises to lead him to the Best Nap Spot. He journeys through dreamy landscapes before discovering the perfect place was home all along.

ned.name: Ned
ned.visual_shorthand: Boy (5) with tousled brown hair, oversized blue pajamas with yellow stars, carries a white pillow, droopy sleepy eyes
distinctive_features: oversized blue pajamas with yellow stars

setting_context: Dreamy soft-focus landscapes - dandelion fields, cloud hammocks, cozy animal dens, and Ned's bedroom. Everything has a hazy, sleepy quality with muted pastels and warm golden glows.

story_bible.premise: A sleepy boy follows a magical map through dreamlike locations searching for the perfect nap spot, only to discover it was his own bed all along.
story_bible.setting: Surreal dreamy landscapes that feel like the edge of sleep - soft, hazy, warm, safe
story_bible.visual_style: Soft Focus Dreamscape style: Muted hazy pastels (lavender, soft pink, pale blue, cream, warm gold). Everything slightly fuzzy at edges like seeing through sleepy eyes. Floating elements (feathers, dandelion seeds, tiny stars) drift through scenes. Warm golden glows around cozy spots. Gets progressively softer and hazier as Ned gets sleepier.
story_bible.emotional_arc: tired curiosity → dreamy wandering → peaceful discovery → cozy contentment

reference_prompt:
9-PANEL STYLE REFERENCE for children's book 'The Nap Map'

VISUAL STYLE: Soft Focus Dreamscape - muted hazy pastels, fuzzy edges, warm golden glows, floating elements. Sleepy, dreamy atmosphere.

Row 1 - CHARACTER NED:
[1] Ned standing sleepy: Boy (5) with tousled brown hair, oversized blue pajamas with yellow stars, hugging white fluffy pillow, droopy eyes, yawning. Soft bedroom light.
[2] Ned walking: Same boy shuffling along, pillow dragging, eyes half-closed. Dreamy pastel background.
[3] Ned sleeping: Same boy curled up peacefully, pillow under head, gentle smile, surrounded by warm golden glow.

Row 2 - DREAMY LOCATIONS:
[4] Dandelion field: Endless soft white dandelion puffs, seeds floating in air, pale blue sky, hazy and dreamy, warm sunlight filtering through.
[5] Cloud hammock: Fluffy white clouds forming a hammock shape, soft pink and lavender sky, tiny stars twinkling, floating feathers.
[6] Cozy den: Warm burrow with sleeping animals (bunny, fox kit), soft mossy bed, golden lantern light, roots forming ceiling.

Row 3 - MAGIC ELEMENTS:
[7] The magic map: Glowing golden parchment with swirly dream-like path drawn on it, sparkles emanating, held by small hands.
[8] Ned's bedroom: Cozy bed with star-pattern blanket, soft nightlight glow, window showing moon, warm and inviting, slightly fuzzy edges.
[9] Golden glow effect: Warm radiating light, floating particles, sense of comfort and sleepiness, soft focus.

STYLE: Soft pastels, hazy edges, dreamy atmosphere, warm glows. NO TEXT.

pages.text:
The map led to a cozy den.
A bunny and a fox napped there.
pages.scene: Children's book illustration, Soft Focus Dreamscape style. Ned (tousled brown hair, blue star pajamas, pillow) peeks into a warm underground den. Inside: a baby bunny and a fox kit curl up together on soft moss, fast asleep. A warm golden lantern glows. Tree roots form the ceiling. Everything is cozy, warm, earthy browns and soft greens with golden light. Hazy, dreamy atmosphere. Peaceful sleeping animals.

pages.text:

Everything is very hazy and soft now, reflecting his sleepiness.

pages.text:
The map led Ned back.
His bed began to glow!
pages.scene: Children's book illustration, Soft Focus Dreamscape style. Ned (tousled brown hair, blue star pajamas, barely awake) shuffles back into his bedroom. His own bed now radiates a beautiful warm golden glow, like it's the most magical place in the world. The star-patterned blanket seems to shimmer. Everything else is soft and hazy. The map points directly at the glowing bed. Ned's eyes widen slightly with sleepy recognition. Home was the answer all along.

Children's book illustration, Soft Focus Dreamscape style. parent_tips.before_reading: Ask: Where is your favorite place to take a nap? Do you have a special pillow or blanket? Look at the cover - where do you think the map will lead Ned?
parent_tips.during_reading: Help with 'pillow', 'sleepy', and 'perfect' - these are heart words. Sound out: nap, map, bed, Ned, got, not, spot, hop, top, run, sun, big.
parent_tips.after_reading: Draw your own nap map! What dreamy places would you visit? What makes your bed the perfect nap spot?
